strings.ui.translationReview: Afrikaans and isiZulu translations are machine-drafted; native-speaker review is pending.
strings.ui.heroDescription: Tell us what happened. CivicOps brings voice, service tickets and accountable AI into one desk. A dispatcher approves every crew assignment.
strings.ui.emergencyNumbers: This desk cannot dispatch emergency responders. For immediate danger in South Africa call 10111 (police), 10177 (ambulance/fire) or 112 from a mobile.
strings.ui.emergencySafety: Keep away from exposed wires, fire and floodwater. We cannot promise an arrival time.
strings.ui.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the issue and any hazards. Use synthetic details in this demo.
strings.ui.descriptionHint: 10–4,000 characters. Location and routing are unverified until staff review. Avoid names, identity numbers and sensitive personal details.
strings.ui.contactConsent: I consent to service updates using this contact.
strings.ui.privacyConsent: I agree to processing for this service-report purpose (privacy notice v1).
strings.ui.privacyOfficerPending: Information Officer contact: owner-pending. Use synthetic data until the municipality publishes its approved privacy notice.
strings.ui.privateHint: A private ElevenLabs session starts when you choose a channel. Voice uses your microphone; session credentials stay in memory.
strings.ui.simulatedHint: Simulated resident agent · deterministic and offline capable while the server is available. Reports use the same backend tools as the live voice agent.
strings.ui.greeting: Hello. Describe the issue and area, or paste a case reference to check its status. A human approves every dispatch.
strings.ui.chatConsent: I agree to municipal processing of this report for service assessment and management (privacy notice v1). Contact is optional.
strings.ui.agentUnavailable: Voice/chat is unavailable in this browser. Use the report form and keep your case reference.
strings.ui.zuluVoiceUnavailable: isiZulu live voice is not configured or verified. Use the isiZulu report form or simulated text desk. English and Afrikaans voice presets require owner validation.
strings.ui.reportSuccess: Reference {reference}. Your report is waiting for human review. Keep this reference; no arrival time is promised.
strings.ui.referenceNotFound: Reference not found. Check the reference and try again.
strings.ui.offlineError: Offline. Reconnect before sending. Your draft and retry key are kept in this tab.
strings.ui.chatAcceptPrivacy: Please accept the service-report privacy purpose before sending a report.
strings.ui.retrySafely: You can retry this same message safely.
strings.ui.requestFailed: Request failed ({status}). Please retry or use the report form.
strings.ui.rateLimit: Request limit reached. Please retry in a minute.
strings.ui.connected: CONNECTED · Human approval required for every dispatch
strings.ui.networkDemo: EXPLICIT DEMO · Synthetic reports only · Dispatcher actions are unverified · Email is outbox-only
strings.ui.networkOffline: OFFLINE · Operational data is stale. Reconnect before reporting or dispatching.
strings.ui.networkStale: STALE · Last refresh failed. Actions require the current case version; retry to reconnect.
strings.ui.degradedDemo: EXPLICIT DEMO · SIMULATED providers. Reports are accepted;
strings.ui.degraded: Some providers are degraded or unverified. Reports are accepted;
strings.ui.degradedVoice: use the report form if voice is unavailable
strings.ui.degradedTicket: provider updates use a simulated outbox or wait for delivery
strings.ui.readinessUnknown: Service readiness could not be confirmed. Keep your case reference and retry if a report is not accepted.
strings.ui.sessionInterrupted: Conversation interrupted. Use the report form or reconnect.
strings.privacy.purpose: Assess, route and manage the reported municipal service issue; send service updates only when separately requested.
strings.privacy.notice: I agree that my municipality may process this report to assess and manage the service issue. Contact details are optional and used for service updates only with my separate consent. I can ask the Information Officer for access, correction or anonymisation. I will avoid identity numbers and sensitive personal details.
strings.error.privacyConsent: Explicit consent to the stated service-report purpose is required.
strings.error.privacyVersion: Accept the current privacy consent version before submitting.
strings.error.invalidReport: Check the report fields and try again.
strings.tool.reportRecorded: Your report is recorded for human review. Please keep your case reference. No crew has been dispatched.
strings.tool.notFound: I could not find that reference. Please check it with the resident.
strings.tool.dispatchGate: A dispatcher approves every dispatch. We cannot promise an arrival time.
strings.tool.handoffRecorded: Your request for a human is recorded. A dispatcher will review it; no arrival time is promised.
strings.tool.infoRecorded: Your additional information is recorded for human review.
strings.tool.categoriesPrompt: Tell me what happened and the area.
strings.update.PendingApproval: Report received for human review. No response time is promised.
strings.update.Approved: Human review complete; awaiting crew assignment.
strings.update.Assigned: An eligible crew has been assigned.
strings.update.WaitingForCitizen: Additional resident information has been requested.
strings.update.Resolved: The service desk has marked this report resolved.
strings.comms.PendingApproval: Your report was received and is waiting for human review.
strings.comms.Approved: A dispatcher approved the response. Crew assignment remains a human decision.
strings.comms.Assigned: A dispatcher assigned an eligible crew. There is no confirmed arrival time.
strings.comms.InProgress: The assigned crew is working on the case. There is no confirmed resolution time.
strings.comms.WaitingForCitizen: The team needs more information. Contact the service desk with your reference.
strings.comms.Resolved: A dispatcher marked the case resolved. Contact the service desk if the problem remains.
strings.comms.Closed: The case is closed. Quote this reference if you need further help.
strings.staff.sso-disabled.sso_is_disabled_until: SSO is disabled until an administrator configures an identity provider. Service accounts continue to use scoped bearer tokens.
strings.staff.staff-access.your_assigned_roles_a: Your assigned roles and municipality are verified by the server.
strings.staff.staff-access.this_role_picker_is_a: This role picker is available only in explicit demo mode. It is not a production sign-in.
strings.staff.bootstrap-token.placeholder: Access token supplied by your administrator
strings.staff.control.recommendations_are_visibl: Recommendations are visible. Decisions belong to people.
strings.staff.control.see_agent_reasoning_human_: See agent reasoning, human decisions, ticket delivery and the full timeline.
strings.staff.audit.append_only_events_link_to_t: Append-only events link to the previous SHA-256 hash within this municipality. Integrity is verified against the durable chain.
strings.staff.audit-result.sign_in_with_a_role_p: Sign in with a role permitted to review the audit.
strings.staff.audit.local_integrity_is_verified_: Local integrity is verified. External audit anchoring and deployment verification remain owner work. Closed-case snapshot retention is configurable; the audit chain and integration artifacts are retained.
strings.staff.audit.aria_label: Recorded case events, scroll horizontally on small screens
strings.staff.admin.manage_staff_integrations_an: Manage staff, integrations and qualified teams within your municipality.
strings.staff.admin.your_server_verified_admin_r: Your server-verified admin role is required to view and change municipal configuration.
strings.staff.admin.copy_this_token_now_the_serv: Copy this token now. The server stores only its hash. It disappears when you dismiss it, leave administration, change identity or reload this page.
strings.staff.admin-tenant-help.name_slug_depart: Name, slug, departments, locale defaults and service area are validated by the server. The municipality ID is fixed.
strings.staff.admin.administrative_provisioning_: Administrative provisioning creates a tenant boundary. Operational records remain accessible only within the signed-in municipality.
strings.staff.admin.sso_roles_come_from_configur: SSO roles come from configured claims and groups. These local assignments support staff bootstrap access.
strings.staff.admin.each_account_is_bound_to_thi: Each account is bound to this municipality. Expiry, rotation and revocation are recorded in its audit chain.
strings.staff.admin-catalogue-help.advance_the_s: Advance the semantic version. The server validates the complete schema, skills, certification references and current version before saving.
strings.staff.admin.crew_members_must_belong_to_: Crew members must belong to this municipality. Department, capability, shift and availability are validated.
strings.staff.admin.skills_crew_binding_and_cert: Skills, crew binding and certificate evidence are validated. Save only verified staff evidence; keep demo records synthetic.
strings.staff.admin.record_the_request_verify_id: Record the request, verify identity outside this app without uploading identity documents, then export, correct or anonymise local case data. Legacy audit, backups and provider records require separate Information Officer review.
strings.staff.admin.record_an_access_correction_: Record an access, correction or anonymisation request
strings.staff.admin.request_note_no_identity_doc: Request note (no identity documents or personal details)
strings.staff.admin.verify_and_fulfil_a_recorded: Verify and fulfil a recorded request
strings.staff.admin.identity_verification_note_m: Identity-verification note (method and outcome; omit identity numbers)
strings.staff.admin.resident_separately_requeste: Resident separately requested service updates using this corrected contact.
strings.staff.admin.access_downloads_json_anonym: Access downloads JSON. Anonymisation erases local contact, narrative, transcript and queued request payloads; its audit tombstone and older immutable audit remain.
strings.staff.footer.elevenlabs_triage_on_amd_ze: ElevenLabs voice agent → Culltron intake agents → human response → audit

strings.staff.dynamic.crew_qualification_review_: Crew qualification review is available to municipal operations staff.

strings.staff.dynamic.delivery_records_appear_af: Delivery records appear after the first report.
strings.staff.dynamic.sign_in_to_review_work_wit: Sign in to review work within your municipality.
strings.staff.dynamic.sign_in_with_a_role_permit: Sign in with a role permitted to review the audit.

strings.privacy.locationNotice: Report coordinates are optional. Choose shareLocation only to let authorized municipality staff locate this report, assign its ward and review dispatch. Coordinates are unverified, stored with this case under its retention policy, and can be corrected or anonymised through the Information Officer. CivicOps does not track residents.
